name: prometheus.exporter.statsd

arguments.name: cache_size
arguments.description: Maximum size of your metric mapping cache. Relies on least recently used replacement policy if max size is reached.

arguments.name: cache_type
arguments.description: Metric mapping cache type. Valid options are “lru” and “random”.

arguments.name: event_flush_interval
arguments.description: Maximum time between event queue flushes.

arguments.name: event_flush_threshold
arguments.description: Number of events to hold in queue before flushing.

arguments.name: event_queue_size
arguments.description: Size of internal queue for processing events.

arguments.name: listen_tcp
arguments.description: The TCP address on which to receive statsd metric lines. Use "" to disable it.

arguments.name: listen_udp
arguments.description: The UDP address on which to receive statsd metric lines. Use "" to disable it.

arguments.name: listen_unixgram
arguments.description: The Unixgram socket path to receive statsd metric lines in datagram. Use "" to disable it.

arguments.name: mapping_config_path
arguments.description: The path to a YAML mapping file used to translate specific dot-separated StatsD metrics into labeled Prometheus metrics.

arguments.name: read_buffer
arguments.description: Size (in bytes) of the operating system’s transmit read buffer associated with the UDP or Unixgram connection.

arguments.name: relay_addr
arguments.description: Relay address configuration (UDP endpoint in the format ‘host:port’).

arguments.name: relay_packet_length
arguments.description: Maximum relay output packet length to avoid fragmentation.

arguments.name: unix_socket_mode
arguments.description: The permission mode of the Unix socket.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
